fixes.explanation: That's right. The verse says, "And Hezekiah prospered in all that he did." (2 Chronicles 32:30) Prospered is the word the text gives for his work, and it never says he struggled. So the statement about struggling in most of what he does doesn't match the verse.

Punish sounds heavy, like a burnt batch nobody wants to open the oven on. But look at what the text says: God left him alone "…to test him, that He might know all that was in Hezekiah’s heart." (2 Chronicles 32:31) The verse gives the reason, and it's to know what was in his heart. Test is the word there, so that's the one to stay with.
